source: Minnesota Department of Health, Minnesota County Annual Health Statistics Dashboard (Leading causes of death, county counts, 2021-2024; all deaths = sum of the twelve monthly county counts in Death counts, Deaths by month)
note: Counts as shown in the dashboard's Table tab (measure 1-year crude mortality rate, Count column) for every county; MDH states that only rates and percents are suppressed under 10 deaths, the death counts themselves are published, and zeros are shown as 0. Leading-cause list changes by year: homicide 2023-2024 only, COVID-19 2021-2023 only; other causes 2021-2024. Hypertension, Parkinson disease and congenital malformations (not map measures) are left out. all = the 12 monthly county counts of 'Deaths by month' added up per year (arithmetic on published exact counts). No terms of use are stated on the dashboard; the Suppression section is quoted in terms_log. terms status none_stated. Counts only. Earlier years (before 2021) are available from MDH on request (health.healthstats@state.mn.us).
